title: Kidnapped
desc: Love has many things hidden instore. What happens and Why does it happen? The secrets will be revealed in Kidnapped

title: Trp
desc: A victims father tries to get justice for his daughter despite the failed situation system in place.

title: Signature
desc: A single mother, living in a small village, takes care of her little daughter’s educational expenses by doing tailoring work. One day, she receives a pension letter, for which she has to visit the Gramin bank. There, she encounters something unexpected.

title: The Unsent Letter
desc: Nidhi is haunted by her past; she's caged in it when suddenly she gets interrupted by a waiter asking for her order. After she pulls herself together, she realizes that the waiter had called her by her name. Nidhi finds out that the waiter is a man from her past. She is now left with a choice to face her nightmare and finally let go of everything that has haunted her till now or to continue living her life in a cage.

title: Kshan
desc: After a dinner-time discussion about mental health turns sour, Kamlesh (55) riles his daughter, Disha, a clinical psychologist, into storming off from the gathering. This incites Kamlesh into visiting three doors to his past that make him realise that he himself suffers from a mental health disorder. 'Kshan' is a recollection of a broken man's traumatic events and his realisation that drives him to seek help from his daughter after learning to let go of his ego.

title: Bandage
desc: A young-adult, aspiring boxer, Aditya, trains with his father to become the best. However, he starts questioning his ambition and skills to make it to the top. Battling with his own troubles, the father tries to motivate Aditya. Will the father-son duo emerge victoriously, or will they crumble down in the face of their adversities?

title: Cheater
desc: Love is blind, they say. And, sometimes, quite literally! How many of us are guilty of forgiving our partners once too often for their hurtful actions? When it comes to a cheating spouse, however, you would think there was no scope for forgiveness.

title: Jaane Do Mujhe
desc: Nisha is enjoying her date with Aditya, who was set up by her friends. While Aditya is in the washroom, Nisha hears a loud thud and rushes to check on him. She finds Aditya lying unconscious on the floor. Nisha contacts her friend Priya to inform her about the incident. However, Priya tries to reassure Nisha that it's all in her head and there's nothing to worry about. This raises the question of whether Aditya is still alive or if he exists solely in Nisha's imagination.

title: Qurbat
desc: In a stormy night, tension unfolds in the affluent household of Akram and Noorie, a middle-aged couple. Abdul, their seventy years old servant and his young petite wife Fatima share the space. Each resident of the household is driven by their dark desires. The morbid darkness of the night hides the truth in that household. Qurbat is a dark psychological thriller involving these two women who draw close for their respective liberation.

title: Bhool
desc: A young actor in dire straits assumes the identity of a retired Army Officer's son in real life to leverage his housing arrangement. The officer, battling memory loss, eventually uncovers the harsh reality about his long-lost son, prompting the actor to flee for his life.

title: Humraz
desc: This is the story of a couple who tried to raise their voice against the undesirable practice of one community. Hamraz is a witness to the hero playing Ravanahatha and the incidents that happened to him... Sometimes the image that looks white is also black... Humraz is a story full of mysteries... The curtain will soon fall on all the secrets and the real story will come out in front of everyone..

title: Ae Ajnabi
desc: Pappu, a misunderstood dreamer, carries a ring for the unknown—waiting for love, waiting for meaning. On a fateful night, he meets Chandini, a mysterious stranger who changes his world in just five hours. As they share stories, laughter, and heartbreak, Pappu finds answers he never knew he needed. But was she ever real? Or just a gift from the sun? A poetic journey of love, loss, and destiny.

title: It's A Match!
desc: Saurabh gets a match on a dating app and enlists his friend Shobhit’s help. But when Shobhit steals the spotlight—and the girl—things take a hilarious turn. Lies unravel, friendships are tested, and just when you think it's over… another match changes everything! A fun-filled tale of love, loyalty, and second chances

title: Jevlas Ka
desc: A gym freak eagerly awaits his cheat day, but family drama and an empty wallet stand in his way. As he navigates the chaos of Mumbai, will he find a way to satisfy his cravings, or will the city serve up an even bigger surprise? A fun-filled ride of food, family, and unexpected twists!

title: O Re Saajan
desc: Sajan Tiwari', in his mid 30s, works as a small time estate agent in Lucknow. He is involved in an extra-marital affair. His only son, 5 year old 'Bunty', catches him in the act. Scared out of his wits, 'Sajan' makes every possible effort to stop 'Bunty' breaking the news to his wife 'Manju'. The story is a humorous take on small town life, relationships and family.

title: Ban Chor
desc: A thief sneaks into a wealthy home for an easy heist—only to find the wife’s secret lover already there! But when the husband arrives, the thief and the lover must hide together, leading to a night of pure chaos, panic, and comedy. Because in this house… "Har chor pe ek mor hota hai!"

title: Uljhe Ho Kyun
desc: Fitness influencer Abhay’s quirky habit of messaging his first likes leads him to Srishti, a corporate workaholic. As sparks fly, their contrasting worlds collide in a playful yet unpredictable romance. Will their chemistry sizzle or turn to ashes? A fun, fiery take on modern love.

title: Unfinished Business
desc: A mother’s unwavering love gives her child the strength to face fears, embrace courage, and discover the true meaning of freedom. This inspiring tale celebrates the power of love, resilience, and the journey toward self-discovery.

title: Aam Ka Achaar
desc: Haunted by the riots that took his parents 20 years ago, Karan confronts the man who once loved him as a son—yet betrayed him in the worst way. Torn between revenge and forgiveness, he seeks meaning in the madness. A powerful story of loss, betrayal, and the fight for redemption.

title: Bita Hua Pal
desc: The film delves into the universal question of love and compatibility. It follows the journey of a woman named Mira, who, like many others, finds herself questioning the foundation of her relationship. As she navigates the ups and downs of her own love story, she reflects on the nature of love and the challenges of maintaining a lasting connection.

title: Party Bhaiya Viral Hai
desc: A satirical comedy on social media, Party Bhaiya follows a young man from a small village who becomes infatuated with a social media influencer through her videos. Drawn by his growing attraction, he tracks down her location to express his feelings in person. However, this encounter delivers a jarring reality check, revealing the stark differences between her online persona and real life. But in the unpredictable world of social media, surprises await, and Party Bhaiya, his online alias, learns that appearances can be deceiving.

title: Makdee
desc: This is the story of a woman whose captivating beauty lures men into her world, much like a spider weaving an irresistible web

title: Adarniya Mantri Ji
desc: In a gripping tale, Finance Minister Supriya Chaudhry leads a crackdown on black money with her secretary, Laxman. After seizing 1200 crores, they discover 600 crores are missing. Laxman uncovers a secret plan, revealing himself as the masked figure holding the bank manager hostage. As chaos ensues and the truth unfolds, Laxman informs Supriya of their covert success, leaving viewers with a tense cliff hanger. The story ends with the title Adarniya Mantri Ji, leaving the mystery unresolved.

title: The Red Suitcase
desc: A lone taxi driver’s quiet routine is shattered when she picks up a seemingly innocent passenger carrying a RED suitcase. What begins as a simple ride turns into a twisted journey, as the driver uncovers chilling clues hidden inside the suitcase that lead her into the dark mystery. She must navigate the gritty streets and her growing paranoia to survive a night that will change everything.

title: Maggi
desc: How a delivery guy gets entangled in a game orchestrated by a mysterious woman, leaving him questioning her true intentions.

title: Love Range
desc: In the bustling metro city of Mumbai, Ayush and Roohi's lives are turned upside down by the COVID-19 pandemic. When Ayush loses his job, Roohi decides to start a tiffin service to support the family, but Raj's traditional views and wounded ego create tension as he struggles with the idea of his wife being the breadwinner.

title: Cycle Of Sorrows
desc: Set in a rural village, this heart-wrenching story follows a poor father with a beloved daughter, who still yearns for a son as his pregnant wife prepares to give birth. Driven by financial hardship, he makes a tragic decision that not only shatters his family but leaves his relationship with his daughter and wife forever scarred. Watch this emotional tale of a father’s regret and the lasting impact on his family. Can he undo the damage he’s caused?

title: On The Spot
desc: On a fateful day, Parul hails a taxi to visit her boyfriend Ansh. Ansh, eagerly anticipating her arrival, is thrown into restlessness. However, their journey takes an unexpected turn when the taxi driver receives news of his daughter falling ill. Witnessing this, Parul's compassionate response sparks anger in Ansh. Yet, in the face of adversity, Parul's decision unfolds, offering inspiration to the youth. This is the tale of "On the Spot."

title: Tall Girlfriend Dates Short Guy
desc: In this charming comedy, a couple navigates the ups and downs of their relationship, with him being shorter and her towering over him. From playful teasing by the maid to awkward encounters, his height becomes a source of humor and occasional frustration. However, amidst the laughs and challenges, her unwavering love reassures him that their bond transcends any physical differences. Join them on a delightful journey of love and laughter, where acceptance triumphs over insecurities.

title: Ransom Handsome
desc: Ayan and Kabir are small time criminals involved in the kidnapping of a daughter of a dangerous mob boss, Nicole. All they have to do is stick to a kidnapping checklist and check off items as they come to pass. But their novice actions force them to interact with Nicole. Her innocent interactions result in a significantly jacked up ransom amount. Nicole manipulates the situation. Ayan and Kabir struggle to survive as Nicole starts executing her master plan to leave no witnesses behind

title: Pardesi Love
desc: The central theme of "Pardesi Love" focuses on a romance involving an Indian taxi driver and a foreign woman who arrives in India from Canada to meet her online boyfriend and fulfill her mother's final rites. However, the situation is far from straightforward. Jasmin intends to wed her boyfriend, Sunny, and establish a life in India, while simultaneously, the cab driver, Satya, develops feelings for her. Yet, the complexities of their relationships and interactions form the crux of the film's narrative, showcasing the dynamic among these three individuals.

title: Nazariyaa
desc: Mihika, a 22 year old, fights with her dad yet again over going out late at night. She finds it very unreasonable of him to be so worried now that she’s 22. Waiting for her cab, she overhears her building’s supervisor talking on a phone call with his own daughter. She steps in and debates with him about how he shouldn’t be upset about her being out late at night but understands his perspective too in the process. She then goes back home to apologise and reconcile with her dad. The supervisor also understands his daughter’s situation better through this chance encounter.
